scope: Curated theme collection and complete system appearances
native_checks: All ten originals render and keep automatic shell tint out of their backgrounds
Theme changes preserve personal typography, motion and sounds
Edited Carbon survives light/dark transitions and preference reload
An explicitly selected system theme survives enabling Follow OS
Legacy tinted Paper source remains editable after resolving to light text
Editor, terminal, theme picker and narrow settings hit bounds

heap_recovery.note: Run before final card preview and fresh-profile metadata changes; artwork implementation unchanged afterward.

limitations: Native acceptance was run on macOS, not Windows or Linux.
System appearance transitions invoked the same app handler without changing the host OS setting.
Contrast assertions cover resolved theme tokens; external web/program colors and user opacity settings can differ.
The running dist/nus.app and its profile were not replaced or relaunched.
